features.name: Automatic Shopify URL Configuration
features.description: The connector now automatically updates and constructs the Shopify admin URL, eliminating the need for manual URL configuration when setting up the connector.

features.name: Inventory Minus Reservation Calculation
features.description: A built-in inventory calculation method that subtracts reservations from total inventory, reducing the need for customers to build custom extensions.
caveats: requires extensibility configuration to use alternative inventory calculations

features.name: Dynamic Guidance Notifications
features.description: Contextual notifications on the product list that help users understand the next steps for pushing or importing data to Shopify, adapting based on the user's action needs.

features.name: Shipment Confirmation Control
features.description: A new setting that allows companies to disable automatic shipment confirmation notifications to Shopify, useful for digital goods where fulfillment details are not needed.

features.name: Default Refunds and Returns Importing
features.description: The connector now imports refunds and returns by default, a minor change from previous behavior that improves data accuracy between Shopify and Business Central.

features.name: B2B on Shopify Platform
features.description: A suite of wholesale features built into Shopify's core platform enabling unified commerce for B2B and D2C operations with full customization and integration capabilities.
caveats: requires Shopify plan with B2B capabilities

features.name: B2B Customizable Buying Experience
features.description: Merchants can fully control and customize the wholesale buying experience including product availability, price lists, payment terms, shipping methods on a per-customer basis without coding.

features.name: B2B Business Central Integration
features.description: Enhanced integration between Shopify B2B and Microsoft Business Central enabling seamless synchronization of company data, catalogs, and order management between systems.

features.name: D2C Customer Synchronization Control
features.description: Improved customer synchronization allowing merchants to select specific D2C customers to export to Shopify instead of a global boolean setting, providing more granular control.

features.name: B2B Company Synchronization
features.description: Synchronized settings for B2B company export to Shopify including configurable default contact permissions and automatic catalog creation options.

features.name: Default Contact Permissions Configuration
features.description: Settings to configure default permissions for main contacts created in B2B companies, with options for no permissions, ordering only, or location admin access.

features.name: Automatic Catalog Creation for Companies
features.description: Optional automatic catalog creation when new companies are created in Shopify, with the ability to disable and manually manage catalogs instead.
caveats: automatic creation can be disabled for manual catalog management

features.name: B2B Catalog Management
features.description: Manual and flexible catalog creation for B2B companies allowing selective product inclusion, with ability to assign catalogs to multiple companies and differentiate B2B from D2C product availability.

features.name: B2B Modern Authorization
features.description: Shopify's modern authorization for B2B customers using email-based verification with six-digit codes instead of traditional login credentials.

features.name: Company-Specific Catalogs
features.description: B2B customers can be assigned to specific companies with associated catalogs in Shopify admin, allowing different product selections and pricing per company.

features.name: Get Catalogs Action
features.description: A new action in Business Central to retrieve catalogs from Shopify for synchronized companies, creating catalog records for B2B operations.
caveats: only retrieves catalogs for companies already synchronized with Business Central

features.name: Catalog Price Synchronization
features.description: Ability to sync prices from catalogs to Shopify storefront, including applying discounts and line discounts defined in Business Central catalog settings.

features.name: B2B Checkout with Company Assignment
features.description: B2B checkout experience shows company name, user name, multiple company addresses, and allows users to enter PO numbers for payment tracking.
caveats: payment may be configured to occur outside of Shopify checkout

features.name: B2B vs D2C Order Differentiation
features.description: Orders placed by B2B users are assigned to the company entity, while D2C orders are assigned to the individual person, allowing different handling in Business Central.

features.name: Cancel Order Action
features.description: New action to cancel orders imported from Shopify with ability to notify customers, specify reason, and automatically restock items.

features.name: Order Status Synchronization
features.description: Order statuses from Business Central are synchronized back to Shopify, including paid status and cancellation status for merchant visibility.

features.name: Order Editing with Refunds
features.description: Merchants can edit orders in Shopify after placement, including removing items and replacing them with others, with refunds processed for price differences.

features.name: Intelligent Credit Memo Creation
features.description: Business Central automatically creates credit memos only from refunds with actual amounts, filtering out zero-value refunds from Shopify order edits.

features.name: Synchronize Order and Unlink Actions
features.description: Two main actions for handling already-processed orders that receive edits: Synchronize Order to detect errors, and Unlink Process Documents to reset and reprocess from Shopify.
caveats: requires manual decision on company processes when conflicts occur

features.name: Order Error Detection for Received Edits
features.description: The system now detects when an order has been processed but receives an addition or edit that impacts the order amount, particularly for items that have already been paid.
caveats: Error detection only notifies users; automatic modification of documents is not possible
Shopify lacks detailed warehouse handling information

features.name: Synchronize Order from Shopify Action
features.description: Main action that allows users to synchronize an order from Shopify, re-importing and reprocessing the order data to handle edits and discrepancies.
caveats: Requires manual user action to resolve complex situations

features.name: Unlink Process Documents Action
features.description: Action that allows users to unlink a processed order and reprocess it as new, essentially resetting it to handle subsequent edits from Shopify independently.
caveats: Works best for scenarios not yet integrated into warehouse processing

features.name: Automatic Credit Memo Creation for Refunds
features.description: System can automatically create credit memos when Shopify edits involve refunds, enabling coordinated processing of both the order edit and the financial adjustment.
caveats: Only works when refund information is available from Shopify
Cannot create credit memo if refund was not triggered

features.name: Edit and Refund Processing for Paid Orders
features.description: For orders already paid in Shopify, the connector supports either separate handling of edits and refunds or processing them together as a combined operation.
caveats: Requires manual process decisions by companies

features.name: Edit Support for Unpaid Orders
features.description: Shopify allows edits for orders without payments, and the connector supports these modifications without requiring refund handling.

features.name: User Notification for Conflicting Documents
features.description: When a document in Business Central has already been created but receives subsequent edits from Shopify, the system displays warnings and notifications to alert users of the conflict.
caveats: Notification-only approach; requires manual user intervention
System cannot automatically modify documents once created
